page.overview:
Who is 13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga?

13th Order Fugleman Zo Ga is a non-player character from Final Fantasy XIV. He is the antagonist of the Kobold Beast Tribe quests.

Zo Ga exiled the 789th Order because of her incompetence at work and refused any attempt at their later efforts. Zo Ga also forces Bi Bi to create an oven prototype that he could use to punish opposing him. Following an attempted attack on Camp Overlook, Zo Ga discovers Bi Bi's involvement with the 789th Order and arrests her. Gi Gu and the Warrior of Light invade the mines and blow up all the ovens, when Zo Ga ambushes the duo he ends up defeated by Gi Gu.
